Refined traditional Chinese ink with delicate translucent watercolor on warm ivory xuan paper, restrained celadon, soft ochre and ink grey, naturally textured brushwork, airy lyrical depth. Tang-era clothing, architecture and objects if relevant. CRITICAL COMPOSITION: main subjects are confined to the TOP 25–30% of the tall sheet, softly dissolving into ivory mist by 33% height. Poem (semantic reference only, do not paint words): 自叙 — 杜荀鹤
酒瓮琴书伴病身，熟谙时事乐于贫。
宁为宇宙闲吟客，怕作乾坤窃禄人。
诗旨未能忘救物，世情奈值不容真。
平生肺腑无言处，白发吾唐一逸人。
visualReview: 年长诗人在朴素屋内端坐，案头琴、酒瓮与书相伴，面向窗外不卑不亢；没有奢华陈设，中下部纸面开阔。
